climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: An Idaho AVA northwest of Boise and the first sub-appellation of the Snake River Valley AVA. Elevations run from 2,490 to 3,412 feet, with vineyards below 3,000 feet. The climate is cool, and most vines are at one vineyard in the center.
